gate: C9 projectable HMT U(1) RG-transfer audit
question: Do the currently source-locked quantitative one-loop/RG results for ordinary projectable Horava gravity already extend, without additional assumptions, to the projectable HMT local-U(1) theory containing the gauge field A and Newtonian prepotential nu?

required_sources.required_claim: quantitative 3+1-dimensional beta functions are established for ordinary projectable Horava gravity
quantitative RG flow is established for ordinary projectable Horava gravity
the U(1)-extended theory contains the additional gauge field A and Newtonian prepotential nu; the projectable U(1) version has a distinct constrained field content

decision_rule: PASS_SCOPED means the audited source sets establish quantitative RG control for the ordinary projectable parent and a classically constrained projectable HMT U(1) extension with additional A,nu fields, but do not themselves provide an explicit one-loop equivalence/transfer theorem for the U(1)-extended gauge-fixed Hessian, ghost sector and beta functions. It is not a literature-wide no-go claim.
nonclaims: No claim that a projectable HMT U(1) theory is nonrenormalizable.
No claim that an HMT U(1) one-loop calculation cannot be constructed.
No transfer of ordinary-projectable beta functions to the HMT U(1) completion without an explicit derivation.
No quantitative beta functions for the unresolved HMT physical-matter interface.
No closure of full C9 radiative naturalness.
No soft-s or k=0.03 production gate is reopened.
